annotations.title: User agent parser: browser, OS, device and bots

description: Parse a User-Agent string into browser and version, operating system and version, device type (desktop, mobile, tablet or bot) and, for crawlers, which bot it is: Googlebot, Bingbot, GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, social previewers, SEO crawlers and HTTP libraries such as curl or python-requests. Local rules, no outside service. Use to read access logs, segment traffic or spot AI crawlers. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: useragent_parse
